Careers

Join our team and revolutionize supply chain planning

About InteliChain

At InteliChain, we believe the future of supply chain planning belongs to those who can think, adapt, and act with intelligence. We build that intelligence. By doing so InteliChain is redefining how the world’s supply chains are planned and optimized.

Our technology combines AI, Gen-AI, and Machine Learning to reinvent how manufacturers, distributors, and retailers plan, forecast, and optimize their operations.

InteliChain transforms supply chain planning from a static process into a living, learning system that continuously senses change, predicts outcomes, and drives better decisions.

By merging advanced analytics with deep operational expertise, we help global organizations achieve clarity, agility, and resilience in the face of uncertainty.

After proving our impact with leading enterprises, we are now scaling globally and seeking a visionary commercial leader to help shape the next phase of growth.

 

The Opportunity

We are searching for a VP Sales who will build and lead InteliChain’s global sales organization and drive our expansion to new markets.

You will define our commercial strategy, shape our go-to-market model, and lead enterprise growth across industries and geographies.

This is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing AI company at the perfect moment, with proven technology, world-class clients, and strong product–market fit.

 

Role Description

  • Lead the global sales organization from strategy to execution
  • Design and implement go-to-market strategies across SaaS, consulting, and enterprise solutions
  • Own revenue growth, pipeline management, and forecasting
  • Build relationships with decision-makers at leading industrial and technology companies
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and delivery teams to align sales with business goals
  • Represent InteliChain at global conferences and industry events
  • Recruit, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team
  • This is a full-time onsite position based in Ra’anana.

 

Who you are…

  • A proven sales executive with at least 8 years of experience in B2B or SaaS enterprise sales
  • Experienced in international markets and complex deal cycles
  • Skilled at both strategy and hands-on deal execution
  • Strong communicator with credibility at the C-level
  • Passionate about AI, analytics, and the transformation of supply chain operations
  • A growth-minded leader who thrives in a fast-moving

We’re looking for passionate professionals to grow with us. If you’re ready to make an impact in a fast-paced, innovative environment, we want to hear from you!

Contact us: Send your application to info@inteli-chain.com.
Please mention the position title in the subject line.

Join us

Job Description

As an SDR, you will promote Intelichain’s cutting-edge solutions and courses, generate high-quality leads, and work closely with the sales team to drive revenue growth. The role includes cold calling, inside sales, proactive outbound prospecting, lead generation, and scheduling meetings with potential clients, primarily in Israel.

Qualifications

  • Strong lead generation and business development skills
  • Comfortable with cold calling and phone-based outreach
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and adaptable to different client needs
  • Fluent in Hebrew and English – a must

This is a full-time onsite position based in Ra’anana.

Join us in transforming the supply chain landscape!

Join us

Job description

We’re looking for a versatile Full Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to join our fast-moving team. You’ll play a central role in building and scaling our systems, working across the stack but especially owning backend services and data infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable backend services using FastAPI (Python)
  • Work closely with PostgreSQL databases to model data and write performant queries
  • Collaborate across the stack, including contributions to a React frontend when needed
  • Debug hard problems across distributed systems, databases, and application layers
  • Thrive in a startup environment: wear multiple hats, adapt to changing priorities, and ship quickly without cutting corners

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–7 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript (or both)
  • Solid understanding of SQL and hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Experience building production systems with async web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Node.js)
  • Comfort with debugging complex issues and working independently in ambiguous situations
  • A flexible, collaborative mindset—you’re energized by working on a little bit of everything
  • Fluent in Hebrew and English – a must

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with machine learning algorithms or data science workflows
  • Familiarity with Redis for caching or pub/sub
  • Frontend experience with React

This is a full-time on-site role located in Raanana.

Join us

Job description

We are looking for a Supply Chain Scientist with experience in demand and inventory planning. You’ll work on developing and refining models to improve forecasting, optimize stock levels, and enhance overall supply chain efficiency.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement demand planning and inventory optimization models
  • Analyze historical data to improve forecast accuracy and supply chain performance
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver insights
  • Apply machine learning techniques to enhance decision-making processes
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost reductions

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, or supply chain roles
  • Strong background in statistical modeling and data analysis
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL)
  • Knowledge of machine learning models and forecasting techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills
Join us

Job Description:

We’re seeking a talented Supply Chain Innovation Lead to join our dynamic team. You’ll collaborate with industry-leading clients, focusing on process optimization and methodology refinement.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex consulting projects across various industries.
  • Improve and enhance demand and inventory planning methodologies.
  • Provide expert solutions to boost supply chain efficiency.
  • Analyze & optimize supply chain processes for leading industry clients.
  • Contribute to developing and delivering training courses and workshops.
  • Collaborate with the Product team on SAAS solution enhancements.
  • Assist with implementing our SAAS solutions into client operations.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in supply chain planning, with a strong focus on demand and inventory planning.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Deep understanding of supply chain processes and best practices.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering.
